## add\_part

```json
{
  "description": "Place a new part on the board at (x_mm, y_mm). The new part's id is returned in the result (`created`) and in the `after` snapshot of the part delta. Fails if the designator is already used.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "description": "Places a new part on the board.",
    "properties": {
      "designator": {
        "description": "Reference designator, e.g. \"R1\". Must be non-empty and unique on the board.",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "expected_project": {
        "description": "Optional project identity guard for a placement draft opened before switching documents.",
        "format": "uuid",
        "type": [
          "string",
          "null"
        ]
      },
      "footprint": {
        "description": "Footprint name, e.g. \"R_0603\". Must be non-empty.",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "rotation_deg": {
        "description": "Counter-clockwise rotation in degrees (default 0). Normalised to [0, 360) with 0.001° resolution.",
        "format": "double",
        "type": [
          "number",
          "null"
        ]
      },
      "side": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "description": "Board side a part is mounted on. Serialises as `\"top\"` or `\"bottom\"`.",
            "oneOf": [
              {
                "const": "top",
                "description": "Component (top) side.",
                "type": "string"
              },
              {
                "const": "bottom",
                "description": "Solder (bottom) side.",
                "type": "string"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "type": "null"
          }
        ],
        "description": "Board side, \"top\" or \"bottom\" (default \"top\")."
      },
      "value": {
        "description": "Component value, e.g. \"10k\" or \"100nF\". May be empty.",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "x_mm": {
        "description": "X position of the part origin, in millimetres.",
        "format": "double",
        "type": "number"
      },
      "y_mm": {
        "description": "Y position of the part origin, in millimetres.",
        "format": "double",
        "type": "number"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "designator",
      "value",
      "footprint",
      "x_mm",
      "y_mm"
    ],
    "title": "AddPart",
    "type": "object"
  },
  "name": "add_part"
}
```

Keep existing numeric aliases must be unique ignoring prefix case/leading zeros. Bounded 100 sheets/2000 symbols/10000 combined rows, pins, packages and members/256KiB text/2MiB expected_sheets/2MiB+8KiB whole-command envelope. Preserves UUIDs, pins, geometry and board; one sheet-scoped undo transaction. New previews include a full cursor; packages require it. Stale cursor or sheets reject. ## export\_assembly\_csv

```json
{
  "description": "Export assembly CSV to a local path. bom/placement are all-component inventories ignoring population; sourcing_bom includes explicit sourcing and population for all parts. Placement uses component origins in global mm, Y down, CCW top view, stored bottom transform; no verified centroids. catalog_bom and assembly_bom include populated components only, with strict reference/required-field validation and at most200 references per row. Catalog requires explicit LCSC/JLCPCB supplier and C-digits SKU; assembly requires explicit manufacturer MPN. assembly_placement includes populated components only and requires explicit mounting plus local centroid/zero_axis_mdeg calibration. It emits global-origin mm, X right/Y up, positive CCW common top-view marker rotation: top=r+marker, bottom=r+180-marker modulo360; not a universal vendor zero. No lookup, stock or manufacturer acceptance is verified. Refuses existing files unless overwrite=true, protects captured/current active native files. Optional expected_cursor guards capture; returns exported_cursor and included component_count. Limits:100000 source components,4096 bytes/header,2 MiB aggregate text,32 MiB output,2 retained snapshots/process. Does not change design/history/dirty state.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "expected_cursor": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "sequence": {
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "stream_id": {
            "format": "uuid",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "stream_id",
          "sequence"
        ],
        "type": [
          "object",
          "null"
        ]
      },
      "kind": {
        "enum": [
          "bom",
          "placement",
          "sourcing_bom",
          "catalog_bom",
          "assembly_bom",
          "assembly_placement"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "overwrite": {
        "default": false,
        "type": "boolean"
      },
      "path": {
        "minLength": 1,
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "kind",
      "path"
    ],
    "type": "object"
  },
  "name": "export_assembly_csv"
}

```json
{
  "description": "Export an immutable snapshot to a NEW directory: two outer Gerber X2 copper layers, mask openings, explicit polygon profile/cutouts and XNC Excellon-subset through-via drill. All files metric, common model origin, X right/Y up, top view, bottom files not mirrored. Requires explicit pads and outline; no legacy preview inference, inner copper/pours, routing or fabrication certification. Existing destinations always reject. mask_expansion_mm defaults to 0 mm (0–10); all vias untented. include_silkscreen defaults false; true adds positive Legend Top/Bot files of stored straight strokes, no synthetic bodies, text, clipping or courtyard checks. Optional expected_cursor guards snapshot. Returns exported_cursor and manifest; preserves design/history/dirty state. Board-only snapshot; at most200000 primitives,4096 bytes/string,2 MiB aggregate text,128 MiB output. Shared two-snapshot process admission rejects busy requests.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "expected_cursor": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "sequence": {
            "minimum": 0,

          },
          "stream_id": {
            "format": "uuid",

        ],

## merge\_pcb\_branch

```json
{
  "description": "Explicitly merge own branch using original project/full source cursor and exact branch revision. Refuses busy/stale/reopened or any before-object mismatch atomically; no rebase. Commits retained generated IDs in one normal undoable transaction attributed to creator, normal automatic DRC scheduling. Successful merge removes branch. This is voluntary preparation, not enforced approval security.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "branch_id": {
        "description": "Stable identifier of a model object (project, sheet, part, ...).\n\nA random (version 4) UUID, assigned once when the object is created and kept\nfor its whole life, across moves, edits, undo and save/load. Serialises as the\nhyphenated UUID string, e.g. `\"67e55044-10b1-426f-9247-bb680e5fe0c8\"`.",
        "format": "uuid",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "expected_cursor": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Last consumed event in one engine session. Reusable by any connection.",
        "properties": {
          "sequence": {
            "description": "Last consumed sequence, zero before the first event.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "stream_id": {
            "description": "Random engine session ID; changes on restart.",
            "format": "uuid",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "stream_id",
          "sequence"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "expected_project": {
        "description": "Stable identifier of a model object (project, sheet, part, ...).\n\nA random (version 4) UUID, assigned once when the object is created and kept\nfor its whole life, across moves, edits, undo and save/load. Serialises as the\nhyphenated UUID string, e.g. `\"67e55044-10b1-426f-9247-bb680e5fe0c8\"`.",
        "format": "uuid",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "expected_revision": {
        "format": "uint64",
        "minimum": 0,
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "branch_id",
      "expected_revision",
      "expected_project",
      "expected_cursor"
    ],
    "title": "MergePcbBranch",
    "type": "object"
  },
  "name": "merge_pcb_branch"
}

Explicit reference must be unique globally; exact integer Nm position, rotation_quarters0..3 and local X mirror. Template at most1024 pins/256KiB text; selected sheet at most10000 objects/10000 pins/2MiB text; global validation at most100000 identities/1000 sheets/4MiB text.
